Name: [StreamPulse] Measures have a description
Description: Every measure explains its business meaning in a /// description (CLAUDE.md, ADR-011).

Name: [StreamPulse] Columns have a description
Description: Every column, hidden or not, has a /// description (PLAN.md Phase 5).

Name: [StreamPulse] Measures have a format string
Description: Every measure has a format string or a dynamic format string.

Name: [StreamPulse] Visible measures are in a display folder
Description: Visible measures are grouped in display folders by subject.

Name: [StreamPulse] Auto date/time is off
Description: Auto date/time adds a hidden date table per date column; the model uses its own Date table.

Name: [StreamPulse] Financial columns are hidden from Content Analyst
Description: Columns with amounts (*_eur, *_local, mrr_*) are secured with object-level security in the Content Analyst role (ADR-011).
Expression: (Name.EndsWith("_eur") or Name.EndsWith("_local") or Name.StartsWith("mrr_")) and ObjectLevelSecurity["Content Analyst"].ToString() <> "None"

Name: [StreamPulse] Relationships filter in one direction
Description: Bidirectional filters make results hard to predict and slow; use them only with a documented exception.
